decision_points.condition: UE is in state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED and needs to perform initial registration (various triggers listed a-g).

outcomes.outcome: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST, start T3510.

decision_points.condition: Timer T3502 is currently running.

outcomes.outcome: Stop timer T3502 before sending REGISTRATION REQUEST.

decision_points.condition: Timer T3511 is currently running.

outcomes.outcome: Stop timer T3511 before sending REGISTRATION REQUEST.

decision_points.condition: SUCI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE and timer T3519 is not running.

outcomes.outcome: Start timer T3519 and store the SUCI value.

decision_points.condition: UE has a valid 5G NAS security context and needs to send non-cleartext IEs.

outcomes.outcome: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST including the NAS message container IE.

decision_points.condition: UE has a valid 5G NAS security context and does not need to send non-cleartext IEs.

outcomes.outcome: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST without including the NAS message container IE.

decision_points.condition: UE does not have a valid 5G NAS security context.

outcomes.outcome: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST without including the NAS message container IE. Include entire REGISTRATION REQUEST in NAS message container of subsequent SECURITY MODE COMPLETE.

decision_points.condition: Network receives REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

outcomes.outcome: Network may initiate 5GMM common procedures (identification, authentication, security).

decision_points.condition: Registration type is 'emergency registration' and AMF is configured to support emergency registration for unauthenticated SUCIs.

outcomes.outcome: AMF may choose to skip authentication and proceed to security mode control.

decision_points.condition: Network processes the REGISTRATION REQUEST.

outcomes.outcome: Accept
Reject
outcomes.reason: Various reasons (congestion, not allowed, no slices, etc.)

decision_points.condition: Specific IEs requiring acknowledgement (e.g., 5G-GUTI, SOR, Operator AC defs, CAG list, PEIPS, UE radio cap ID, Network slicing updates, NSSRG, S-NSSAI validity, On-demand NSSAI, Alternative NSSAI, Truncated 5G-S-TMSI, service-level-AA pending) are included in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.

outcomes.outcome: AMF starts timer T3550 and enters state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received.

outcomes.outcome: Reset registration attempt counter, enter 5GMM-REGISTERED, set 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.
outcomes.next_step: Check if REGISTRATION COMPLETE needs to be sent

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT contains specific IEs requiring acknowledgement (as listed for AMF starting T3550).

outcomes.outcome: UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.4: UE Receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT with CAG Information
decision_points.condition: Received 'CAG information list' makes current cell unauthorized.

outcomes.outcome: Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and search for suitable cell.
outcomes.reason: Current CAG cell not allowed based on updated list.

outcomes.outcome: Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and perform PLMN selection.
outcomes.reason: Current CAG cell not allowed, UE only allowed CAG access, and no authorized CAGs available.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.4: UE Receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT with CAG Information
decision_points.condition: Received 'CAG information list' indicates UE only allowed CAG access, but UE is on non-CAG cell.

outcomes.outcome: Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and search for suitable cell.
outcomes.reason: UE only allowed CAG access, must find CAG cell.

outcomes.outcome: Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and perform PLMN selection.
outcomes.reason: UE only allowed CAG access, no authorized CAGs available.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.4: UE Receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT with SOR Container
decision_points.condition: SOR transparent container IE successfully passes integrity check.

outcomes.outcome: Store SOR counter, proceed per TS 23.122 Annex C. Send REGISTRATION COMPLETE (with ack if requested).
outcomes.next_step: UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED / PLMN Selection per SOR

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.4: UE Receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT with SOR Container
decision_points.condition: SOR transparent container IE fails integrity check.

outcomes.outcome: Discard SOR content. Send REGISTRATION COMPLETE if required for other reasons.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.4: UE Receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT with SOR Container
decision_points.condition: SOR container integrity check fails OR SOR container expected but not received, AND UE attempts obtaining service on another PLMN/SNPN per TS 23.122 Annex C.

outcomes.outcome: Locally release the established N1 NAS signalling connection (after sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE if SOR check failed but COMPLETE was needed).

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.4: UE Receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT with specific NSSAI conditions
decision_points.condition: ACCEPT includes 'NSSAA to be performed' indicator, pending NSSAI, but no allowed NSSAI and no partially allowed NSSAI.

outcomes.outcome: Delete stored allowed NSSAI. Restrict initiation of 5GSM procedures (except emergency), Service Request (except specific cases), NAS Transport (except specific containers) until allowed/partially allowed NSSAI received.
outcomes.next_step: Wait for Network Slice procedures / Configuration Update

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION REJECT received with a specific 5GMM cause.

outcomes.outcome: Perform specific actions based on the cause value (e.g., start T3346, add PLMN/TAI to forbidden list, disable N1, retry, PLMN selection, etc.).
outcomes.reason: See detailed actions per cause in 5.5.1.2.5

decision_points.condition: Initial registration for emergency services rejected.

outcomes.outcome: Perform actions per 5.5.1.2.5 cause. Inform upper layers.
outcomes.next_step: Upper layer decision / PLMN Selection (Shared Network)

outcomes.outcome: Perform actions per 5.5.1.2.5 cause. Attempt PLMN/SNPN selection in shared network and retry emergency registration on different PLMN/SNPN (if not already attempted).
outcomes.reason: Failure in shared network, attempting alternative.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.6A: UE Receives REGISTRATION REJECT (Initial Reg for Emergency PDU Session)
decision_points.condition: Initial registration (type 'initial registration') for initiating an emergency PDU session rejected.

outcomes.outcome: Perform actions per 5.5.1.2.5 cause. Inform upper layers.
Perform actions per 5.5.1.2.5 cause. Attempt initial registration for emergency services (type 'emergency registration').

decision_points.condition: Timer T3510 expires.

outcomes.outcome: Abort procedure. Increment counter. If counter < 5, start T3511, enter ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, retry on T3511 expiry.
Abort procedure. Increment counter. If counter = 5, delete context, start T3502 (if > 0), set 5U2, enter ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION/PLMN-SEARCH.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.7: Abnormal Case - Lower Layer Failure / Connection Release
decision_points.condition: Lower layer failure or release of NAS signalling connection before REGISTRATION ACCEPT/REJECT received.

outcomes.outcome: Abort procedure. Increment counter. If counter < 5, start T3511, enter ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, retry on T3511 expiry.
Abort procedure. Increment counter. If counter = 5, delete context, start T3502 (if > 0), set 5U2, enter ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION/PLMN-SEARCH.
outcomes.reason: Max retries reached after lower layer issue.

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION REJECT received with other causes not handled in 5.5.1.2.5 or specific abnormal cases.

outcomes.outcome: Abort procedure. Increment counter (set to 5 for #95, #96, #97, #99, #111). If counter < 5, start T3511, enter ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, retry on T3511 expiry.
Abort procedure. Increment counter. If counter = 5, delete context, start T3502 (if > 0), set 5U2, enter ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION/PLMN-SEARCH.
outcomes.reason: Max retries reached after network rejection (abnormal cause).

decision_points.condition: Timer T3346 is running.

outcomes.outcome: Do not start initial registration.
Start initial registration (if exception applies: high priority, emergency, re-reg required, NB-N1 exception data, emergency PDU session initiation).

decision_points.condition: Lower layers indicate access attempt is barred.

outcomes.outcome: Do not start initial registration.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.7: Abnormal Case - Change in Current TAI
decision_points.condition: Current TAI changes before registration procedure completes.

outcomes.outcome: Abort the registration procedure and re-initiate immediately.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.7: Abnormal Case - Change in Current TAI after ACCEPT, before COMPLETE
decision_points.condition: Current TAI changes after REGISTRATION ACCEPT received but before REGISTRATION COMPLETE sent.

outcomes.outcome: Send REGISTRATION COMPLETE if new TAI is in the TAI list.
Abort initial registration, initiate mobility registration update if new TAI is not in the TAI list.
outcomes.reason: Moved out of registration area before completion.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.7: Abnormal Case - Transmission Failure of REQUEST
decision_points.condition: Lower layers indicate transmission failure of REGISTRATION REQUEST.

outcomes.outcome: Abort the registration procedure and re-initiate immediately.

decision_points.condition: Timer T3550 expires at AMF (1st to 4th time).

outcomes.outcome: Retransmit REGISTRATION ACCEPT, reset and restart T3550.

decision_points.condition: Timer T3550 expires at AMF (5th time).

outcomes.outcome: Abort procedure, enter 5GMM-REGISTERED. Consider old and new 5G-GUTI valid temporarily.
outcomes.reason: Max retries for receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

decision_points.condition: Lower layer failure occurs at AMF before REGISTRATION COMPLETE received (T3550 running).

outcomes.outcome: Abort procedure, enter 5GMM-REGISTERED. Consider old and new 5G-GUTI valid temporarily.

decision_points.step: 5.5.1.2.8: Abnormal Case - New REQUEST after ACCEPT before COMPLETE (Network)
decision_points.condition: New REGISTRATION REQUEST received after ACCEPT sent, before COMPLETE received.

outcomes.outcome: Abort previous procedure, progress new REGISTRATION REQUEST if IEs differ.
Resend REGISTRATION ACCEPT, restart T3550 (no retry increment) if IEs are the same.

dependencies.reason: Procedure initiation requires the UE to be in the DEREGISTERED state.
Common procedures like authentication are optional and depend on information in the request.
Network response depends on processing the request and any associated security procedures.

depends_on: REGISTRATION ACCEPT contains IEs requiring acknowledgement
dependencies.reason: REGISTRATION COMPLETE is only sent upon successful receipt of ACCEPT containing specific IEs.

depends_on: Lower layer failure occurs at AMF
dependencies.reason: Timer T3550 is stopped upon successful completion acknowledgement, subsequent procedure initiation, or failure.

depends_on: Failure of previous attempt (T3510 timeout, specific REJECT, lower layer failure)
dependencies.reason: Retry mechanism is triggered by specific failures and governed by the attempt counter.

depends_on: Failure of previous attempt (T3510 timeout, specific REJECT, lower layer failure)
dependencies.reason: Giving up is triggered by specific failures when the maximum retry limit is reached.
